1.summary: Added is_linked_worktree(path) helper in src/brain/config.rs that detects linked git worktrees via divergent `git rev-parse --git-dir`/`--git-common-dir`, failing open (false) on any git invocation error, with 3 new unit tests (main tree, linked worktree, non-git tempdir).
decisions: Implemented run_git_rev_parse as a private helper shared by both rev-parse calls to avoid duplicating Command::new("git") invocation/parsing logic
Path resolution joins relative git output onto the input path before canonicalizing, per spec instructions

Confirmed pre-existing cargo clippy --all-targets failures (ptr_arg in tests/brain_okf.rs and src/brain/okf.rs, type_complexity in src/brain/state.rs) exist on main before this change (verified via git stash) and are unrelated to Task 1's scope (src/brain/config.rs only) — not fixed here since Task 5 (Validate) and later tasks own the full validation gate

2.summary: EmitState --write now refuses to run (exits FAILURE, writes nothing) when CWD is a linked git worktree via is_linked_worktree(), before find_brain_root is called; dry-run and main-tree behavior unchanged; doc comment updated with new E_EMIT_LINKED_WORKTREE code.
decisions: Guard placed as the very first statement in the EmitState match arm, before find_brain_root, exactly as specified, so the check uses the raw unresolved CLI path arg rather than the resolved brain root

No new tests added in this task since it's a pure control-flow guard using the already-tested is_linked_worktree helper (task 1) and CLI-level test coverage is explicitly task 3's scope per tasks.json

3.summary: Added CLI-level integration tests (real mev binary + real git worktree) covering emit-state --write refusal from a linked worktree, unaffected dry-run, and unchanged --write behavior from the main tree.
decisions: Followed the existing tests/brain_emit.rs module convention (mod-scoped helpers, CARGO_BIN_EXE_mev spawning) already used by other task modules in the same file rather than creating a new test file.
Passed the resolved worktree/main-repo path as the CLI path argument (in addition to setting current_dir) so stderr assertions can reliably match the printed path.
Left the unrelated pre-existing planning/state.json working-tree drift out of this commit since it's outside Task 3 scope.

4.summary: docs/cli.md now documents the E_EMIT_LINKED_WORKTREE refusal for emit-state --write, matching the existing diagnostic-code table style.
decisions: Left the pre-existing uncommitted planning/state.json unicode-escaping diff untouched/unstaged since it is unrelated to Task 4's scope (docs-only change).

5.summary: Ran and confirmed all Validation Commands pass: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo test (317+ tests across all suites, 0 failed), and cargo build --release, all succeeding cleanly for the update-write-state-in-trees ticket.
decisions: Task 5 is validation-only per its spec (no files listed) — made no source changes and therefore no new commit; work from tasks 1-4 was already committed on this branch (66cfd1a, 3aa04db, 7b151eb, 957b4f1).
